title: A coalescing assignment to a property that has a value runs the guard.
text: `$a->x ??= 5` on a `?int` property that is already `4` stores nothing, but it calls `beforePropertySet` with `4`. A guard that throws for that value then fails a statement that writes nothing. `rule:classes/property-observer-pipeline` runs the guard for a `??=` that stores, and says nothing of one that does not. It closes when a `??=` that keeps the value calls no guard, or when the rule says it does, with a conformance case either way.
